what: cost of every published quantization rung, at query time (batch 1)
runtime: @huggingface/transformers in Node (ONNX), the runtime zoteus ships
failure_note: fp16 and q4f16 abort at session init on the ONNX Runtime CPU provider: 'Attempting to get index by a name which does not exist: InsertedPrecisionFreeCast_/emb_ln/Constant_output_0 for node /emb_ln/Mul/SimplifiedLayerNormFusion'. A graph-fusion failure, not a missing kernel; both fp16-bearing rungs are GPU-conditional in practice.
caveats: One process per rung, warm cache: RSS is the total a fresh server process pays (ONNX Runtime and Node included), not the marginal cost of the weights. Loading a second model into a live process costs less, because the runtime is already there.
load_ms is warm — the weights were already downloaded. A first run also pays the download in the size column.
download_mb is the published ONNX file size on the Hugging Face repo, external data files included.
Cost, not quality. Read beside the fidelity ladder, never instead of it.
